info.title: SourceJump API
info.description: Global records for the Counter-Strike: Source bunnyhop community.

get.summary: Answers `ok` while the server is running.

post.summary: Forward an anti-cheat detection. Same retry rules as runs: a `4xx` other than `429` is final; `429`, `5xx` and network errors aren't.

200.description: This server sent this detection before; nothing changed

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked API key

422.description: The report breaks a rule and will never be accepted

post.summary: Ends the session. A form on the website posts here.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: The page to come back to: a path on this site, such as `/maps`. Anything else means `/`.

303.description: Back to the page the player came from, signed out

403.description: Not sent from SourceJump's own pages

post.summary:
Ends every session of the signed-in player, in every browser, and signs this one out. A form on the
website posts here. Unlike signing out, it needs a live session: answering a request without one as if it
had worked would tell the player their other browsers were signed out when nothing was ended.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: The page to come back to: a path on this site, such as `/maps`. Anything else means `/`.

303.description: Back to the page the player came from, signed out everywhere

401.description: Not signed in; no session was ended

403.description: Not sent from SourceJump's own pages

get.summary: Sends the browser to Steam to sign in.

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: The page to come back to: a path on this site, such as `/maps`. Anything else means `/`.

get.summary: Where Steam sends the browser back. Starts a session if Steam confirms the sign-in.

303.description: Back to the page the player came from, signed in; or to the website's sign-in failure page

get.summary: The country codes a profile's details accept.
Players with a recorded time over the last month or year, or ever.
Runs and world records per day over the last month or year, or since the first run.
The top players by points and by completions, in one style and kind of track.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Default: the first style in the current ruleset.

422.description: Limit out of range

get.summary: A whole leaderboard, by points or completions, in one style and kind of track.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Default: the first style in the current ruleset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Players to skip, for paging. Default 0.

422.description: Limit or offset out of range

get.summary: A pre-2.0 run. Runs of players banned from records are hidden, as on the boards.
Maps with at least one run, matching a search, sorted and paged.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Part of a map name or a main-track world record holder's name in the chosen style. Case doesn't
matter; spaces in map names stand for underscores. Exact map names come first, then word starts,
other map matches and record holders, each in the chosen sort; near misses come last.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description:
The style whose main-track world record each map shows. Default: the first style in the current
ruleset.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: A player, by any form of `SteamID`, whose completions `completed` filters by.

parameters.name: completed
parameters.description:
With `player`: true lists only maps whose main track they finished in the list's style, false only the
rest.

parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: Only maps whose main track has this tier.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Maps to skip, for paging. Default 0.

422.description: Limit or offset out of range, a `player` that isn't a SteamID, or `completed` without `player`

get.summary: The map's totals and its world records per track and style.

404.description: SourceJump has no such map, then or now

422.description: Not a valid map name

get.summary:
The map's personal bests for one style and track, ranked, a page at a time. An unknown map is a 404;
a style or track nobody has finished is an empty leaderboard.

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: 0 is the main track (the default), 1 and up are bonuses.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continue after this point: a `next_cursor` from an earlier page of the same view. Leave out for the top.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Which runs to show. Views other than `current` exist only on the normal style's main track.

oneOf.description: Which runs a board or profile shows.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: A player, in any `SteamID` form, whose personal best comes back as `player_entry` whichever page it's on.

422.description: Not a valid map name, track, limit or cursor

get.summary:
These players' SourceJump personal bests on the map, every style and track. An unknown map, or players
without runs on it, give an empty list.

parameters.name: players
parameters.description: Players by SteamID64, comma-separated: 1 to 64 of them. Repeats count once.

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked API key

422.description: Not a valid map name, or `players` isn't 1 to 64 SteamID64s

get.summary: The map's top times per style and track. A map nobody has run yet has an empty list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many places per style and track, 1 to 100. Default 10.

422.description: Not a valid map name or limit

get.summary:
Every run that was faster than all runs before it, in the order they finished. Equalling the record
doesn't count. An unknown map is a 404; a style or track nobody has finished has an empty history.

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: 0 is the main track (the default), 1 and up are bonuses.

422.description: Not a valid map name or track

get.summary: The map's current zone set. 404 means SourceJump has no zones for it, and servers don't submit runs there.

SourceJump-Zone-Set-Version.description: The zone set's version, to tie a run's zone fingerprint to the set it was played on

404.description: SourceJump has no zones for this map

422.description: Not a valid map name

get.summary: The signed-in player, from the session cookie.

Players matching a search, most recently active first; or, with no search, players with runs in the last
30 days.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Part of a name, or a Steam ID in any form. Leave out for recently active players. Names that are
exactly the search come first, then names starting with it, then names containing it; near misses
for a typo come last, closest first.

422.description: Search too short, or limit out of range

get.summary: The player's profile. Takes a `SteamID64`, `SteamID2` or `SteamID3`; the answer always carries the `SteamID64`.

422.description: Not a SteamID

get.summary:
Redirects to the player's Steam avatar. Takes a `SteamID64`, `SteamID2` or `SteamID3`. Only players
SourceJump knows are looked up on Steam; a player known only from the old site gets the avatar it had.

200.description: No avatar yet: a placeholder with the player's initials, cached five minutes

302.description: To the avatar on Steam's CDN; cached a day

422.description: Not a SteamID

put.summary: Change a profile's details: your own, or as staff with `manage_bans`, anyone's.

403.description: Banned from editing, someone else's details without `manage_bans`, or not from SourceJump's pages

422.description: A field breaks a rule, or a staff edit has no reason

get.summary: The player's personal bests in one style or all of them, a page at a time. Takes any `SteamID` form, like the profile.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Style key. Leave out for every style, most recently finished first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continue after this point: a `next_cursor` from an earlier page or the profile. Leave out for the start.

parameters.name: tracks
parameters.description: Main tracks or bonuses only. Leave out for both.

oneOf.description: Which of a map's tracks a list of personal bests covers.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
Which runs to show. Views other than `current` exist only for the normal style's main tracks, and
show those alone.

oneOf.description: Which runs a board or profile shows.

parameters.name: records
parameters.description: True for only the personal bests that rank first: their world records, ties included. 2.0 runs only.

422.description: Not a SteamID, or not a valid limit or cursor

get.summary: The newest plugin release.

404.description: No release has been published yet

get.summary: Published posts, newest first.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only this kind. Leave out for all.

422.description: Not a valid limit or cursor

post.summary: Publish a post. Needs the `post_community` privilege (or `manage_posts`).

403.description: Not allowed to post, or not from SourceJump's pages

422.description: Not a valid post

get.summary: One published post. Takes the ID, or the `{id}-{slug}` pages link with.

parameters.name: post
parameters.description: The post's ID, optionally followed by `-` and its slug

404.description: No such post, or it was removed

put.summary:
Change a post. Its author may, with `post_community`; anyone with `manage_posts` may, giving a reason
for someone else's post. Such an edit is in the staff log, unless it changes nothing.

403.description: Not allowed to change this post

404.description: No such post, or it was removed

422.description: Not a valid post, or staff gave no reason

delete.summary:
Remove your own post from the site. It stays in the database. Staff remove other players' posts with
`POST /v1/staff/posts/{id}/hide`, which asks for a reason.

403.description: Not your post, or not allowed to post

404.description: No such post, or it was removed already

get.summary:
Events about records since a cursor, for servers that poll every 10 to 30 seconds. No key needed: it's
what the site shows.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Continue after this point: the `next` of an earlier answer. Left out: no events, only a `next` that
starts from now.

parameters.name: max_rank
parameters.description:
Only runs that are now at this rank or better on their board, 1 to 100. Default 1, world records.
`invalidated` events are always sent.

422.description: Not a valid cursor or max_rank

get.summary:
The record events as server-sent events: `event:` is the kind, `id:` the event's cursor and `data:` the
event as `GET /v1/records/events` gives it. A comment every 15 s keeps proxies from closing the connection.
Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` to carry on where it stopped. No key needed.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Where to start, as for polling: a `next` or event `id`. A `Last-Event-ID` header wins over it. Neither:
from now.

parameters.name: max_rank
parameters.description:
Only runs that are now at this rank or better on their board, 1 to 100. Default 1, world records.
`invalidated` events are always sent.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The last event's `id`, to resume after it

422.description: Not a valid cursor or max_rank

429.description: This address has the most streams open that one may

get.summary: Download a run's replay, in shavit's replay format 12.

404.description: No replay is stored for this run, it isn't public, or the run was invalidated

get.summary: The current ruleset.

404.description: No ruleset has been published yet

get.summary: The latest valid runs, newest first, a page at a time.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Style key. Left out: every style.

parameters.name: min_tier
parameters.description: Only boards with at least this tier. Boards without a tier are left out once this is set.

parameters.name: records
parameters.description: Only runs that set a world record when they finished.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Runs to skip, for going straight to a page. Default 0. Counted after `cursor` when both are given.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continue after this point: a `next_cursor` from an earlier page with the same filters.

422.description: Not a valid tier, limit, offset or cursor

post.summary:
Submit a finished run. `2xx` means stored; a `4xx` other than `429` is final and the plugin shouldn't retry the run.
Network errors, `5xx` and `429` are temporary: keep the run queued and resend it.

200.description: This server sent this run before; nothing changed

401.description: Missing, unknown or revoked API key

422.description: The run breaks a rule and will never be accepted

get.summary: One run by SourceJump's ID.
A run's comments: the pinned one, then the rest newest first, each with its first replies.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A `next_cursor` from an earlier page; for replies, the last reply shown.

422.description: Not a valid cursor

post.summary:
Comment on a run, or reply to one of its comments. Any signed-in player may, unless banned from posting,
once every 30 seconds.

403.description: Banned from posting, or not from SourceJump's pages

404.description: No such run, or no such comment on it to reply to

422.description: Empty, longer than 1000 characters, or a reply to a reply

delete.summary:
Remove your own comment or reply from the run's page. It stays in the database, and a pinned comment is
unpinned. Staff remove other players' with `POST /v1/staff/run-comments/{id}/hide`, giving a reason.

403.description: Not your comment, or banned from posting

404.description: No such comment on this run, or it was removed already

get.summary: The replies to one comment after the first, oldest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A `next_cursor` from an earlier page; for replies, the last reply shown.

404.description: No such comment on this run

422.description: Not a valid cursor

put.summary: Pin one of the run's top-level comments, replacing any pinned before, or unpin. Only the run's player may.

403.description: Not your run, or banned from posting

404.description: No such run, or no such comment on it

422.description: A reply, which can't be pinned

get.summary:
Listed servers heard from within the `servers` policy's `listed_hours`. Without that policy the list is
empty, rather than guessing how long a server stays listed.
Players and servers online over the last day, week, month or year.

post.summary: Report the server's state and learn its key status. The key is optional.

422.description: Not a valid heartbeat

get.summary: Bans in force and recently ended ones.

post.summary: Lift a ban before its end. The runs it invalidated stay invalid until restored on the runs page.

422.description: Already lifted or ended, your own, or no reason

get.summary:
Every invalidation, newest first, 50 a page, or one player's or server's. A ban is listed while runs sent
during it are invalid.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Only this player's (any `SteamID` form): their runs' invalidations, one or all, and their bans'.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Only this server's (its ID): its runs' invalidations, with any of its keys.

422.description: Not a cursor from this list, or not a SteamID

post.summary: Take every valid run of a player, or every valid run sent with a key, off the boards.

422.description: Neither or both of player and key, yourself, no reason, or no valid runs

get.summary: How many valid and invalidated runs a player or key has.

404.description: SourceJump has no such player or key

422.description: Neither or both of player and key, or not a SteamID

post.summary:
Put back the runs a player's or key's invalidation took that are still invalid. Runs restored or
invalidated separately since are left as they are.

404.description: No player or key invalidation has this ID

422.description: Nothing left to restore but your own runs, or no reason given

get.summary: Every server that holds or held a key, with its current key.

post.summary: Issue a key, for a new server, or for an existing server, revoking its current key in the same step.

422.description: Neither or both of server_id and server_name

post.summary:
Revoke a key, leaving its server without one. Every request with it is refused from then on. The runs the
server sent stay as they are unless `invalidate_runs` is set.

403.description: Needs manage_keys (and invalidate_runs to invalidate), from SourceJump's pages

404.description: No active key has this prefix

422.description: No reason given

put.summary: Show a server on the site's server list. Listing an address that isn't heard from yet is allowed.

422.description: Not an address

delete.summary: Take a server off the site's server list. Its heartbeats are still received.

422.description: Not an address

put.summary: Mark a listed server as a whitelist server: one that lets in only players it has approved.

422.description: Not an address

delete.summary: Mark a listed server as public again.

422.description: Not an address

get.summary: The staff log, newest first, 50 entries a page. Any staff member may read it.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: From a page's `older`: the entries before it.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: From a page's `newer`: the entries after it. Not with `before`.

oneOf.description: What part of the site an action is about, for reading the log one kind at a time.

parameters.name: about
parameters.description:
Only entries about this. A `SteamID`, in any form, finds what the player did and what was done to them or
their runs and posts. Anything else is matched with the target (a map, run or post ID, key prefix,
server address or policy) and with a server's ID or name.

422.description: Not a cursor from this list, or both cursors

get.summary: Every map SourceJump knows, for staff with `manage_maps` or `manage_zones`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Maps to skip, for paging. Default 0.

parameters.name: no_runs
parameters.description: Only maps nobody has finished a run on yet: zoned, or not yet zoned.

get.summary: A map's tiers, image and zone sets. Answers for any valid map name, so staff can prepare a new map.

422.description: Not a valid map name

put.summary: Set or clear the map's public description.

422.description: Too long, or unchanged

post.summary:
Add a picture to the map: the request body is the picture itself (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 15 MB, at least
1920×1080 once cropped to 16:9). SourceJump stores it as 1920×1080 and 480×270 WebP, after the map's
other pictures; a map's first picture is its cover.

422.description: Not a readable picture, too small, already the map's, or 10 already

put.summary: Reorder the map's pictures; the first becomes the cover.

422.description: Not each picture once, or unchanged

delete.summary: Remove one of the map's pictures.

404.description: No such map, or not one of its pictures

put.summary: Move which strip of a picture a short banner shows.

404.description: No such map, or not one of its pictures

422.description: Out of range, or unchanged

get.summary:
The staff log's entries about one map, newest first: tiers, image, banner, description and zones. Any
staff member may read it, as the whole log.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: From a page's `older`: the entries before it.

422.description: Not a valid map name

put.summary: Set when the map was released and who made it, shown under its name.

422.description: Not a SteamID, not a past date, or unchanged

put.summary: Rate one of the map's tracks.

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: 0 for the main track, 1 and up for bonuses

422.description: No tier count, out of range, or unchanged

put.summary:
Set the map's viewer file from an upload: SourceJump checks that stripping it again would change nothing,
then serves it as is. Adds a map SourceJump hasn't seen.

403.description: Needs manage_maps or manage_zones, from SourceJump's pages

422.description: Not a valid map name, nothing uploaded, over 256 MB, or not a packed map

post.summary:
Get a link to upload a packed map to (the `.bsp` stripped for the viewer by SourceJump's packer,
brotli-compressed, up to 256 MB). The upload goes to private storage; nothing is stored for visitors until
it's named in `PUT …/viewer-file`.

403.description: Needs manage_maps or manage_zones, from SourceJump's pages

422.description: Not a valid map name

post.summary: Publish a zone set as the map's next version. Servers load it on their next map start.

409.description: A newer zone set was published since `based_on`

422.description: Not a usable zone set, unchanged, or no note

get.summary: One player as staff see them. Any `SteamID` answers, so staff can act on a player before their first run.

403.description: Needs manage_bans, invalidate_runs, manage_privileges or review_anticheat

422.description: Not a SteamID

post.summary: Ban a player. While banned from records, their new runs are stored invalid and no replay is asked for.

403.description: Needs manage_bans (and invalidate_runs to invalidate), from SourceJump's pages

422.description: Not a SteamID, no restriction or reason, an end in the past, or yourself

get.summary:
One player's anti-cheat detections, 50 at a time, newest first. Any `SteamID` answers, with none for a
player never reported.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: From a page's `older`: the detections before it.

422.description: Not a SteamID or not a detections cursor

get.summary:
The staff log's entries about one player, newest first, up to 100: actions on them, their runs and their
posts. Any staff member may read it, as the whole log.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: From a page's `older`: the entries before it.

422.description: Not a SteamID

post.summary: Grant and revoke a player's privileges. Only what changes is logged; asking for nothing new is refused.

422.description: Not a SteamID, yourself, manage_privileges, no change or no reason

get.summary:
Community posts as the Community page lists them, with removed posts in their place. Staff see these
there instead of the public list.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Only this kind. Leave out for all.

422.description: Not a valid limit or cursor

get.summary: One post, removed or not, so staff can read a removed post on its own page.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The post's ID, optionally followed by `-` and its slug

post.summary: Remove another player's post from the site. It stays in the database and can be restored.

404.description: No such post, or it was removed already

422.description: Your own post, or no reason

post.summary: Put a post staff removed back on the site.

422.description: Removed by its author, your own, or no reason

post.summary: Remove another player's comment from the run's page. It stays in the database and can be restored.

404.description: No such comment, or it was removed already

422.description: Your own comment, or no reason

post.summary: Put a comment staff removed back on the run's page.

422.description: Removed by its author, your own, or no reason

get.summary:
A run's comments as its page lists them, with removed ones in their place. Staff with `manage_posts` see
these there instead of the public list.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A `next_cursor` from an earlier page; for replies, the last reply shown.

422.description: Not a valid cursor

get.summary: One comment's replies after the first, removed ones in place.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: A `next_cursor` from an earlier page; for replies, the last reply shown.

404.description: No such comment on this run

422.description: Not a valid cursor

post.summary:
Take a run off the boards. It keeps its page, which says it was invalidated; if it was a personal best,
the player's next fastest valid run takes its place.

422.description: Already invalidated, your own run, or no reason given

get.summary:
The staff log's entries about one run, for its page: its own invalidations and restores, and what
invalidated it when that was a bulk invalidation or a ban. Any staff member may read it, as the whole log.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: From a page's `older`: the entries before it.

post.summary: Put an invalidated run back on the boards, however it was invalidated.

422.description: Not invalidated, your own run, or no reason given

get.summary: Every map's stored viewer file, for staff uploading many at once.

ActiveKey.description: A key, by its prefix. The key itself is never stored, so it can't be shown again.

peak_players.description:
The most players online at once during the bucket, across listed servers: each server's latest
heartbeat count, summed at the same moment. Up to a month, sampled every 5 minutes; for a year, the
day's highest total at any heartbeat.

players.description: The average player count of each of those servers during the bucket, summed.

servers.description: Listed servers heard from during the bucket.

Aspect.description: A monitor's aspect ratio, from the ones people play on.

Ban.description: A ban, as staff see it.

active.description: Whether it's in force now: not lifted, and its end hasn't passed.

oneOf.description: Null for the server's command line.

ends_at.description: When it ends by itself; null or left out: until lifted.

invalidate_runs.description: Also invalidate every valid run they have. Needs `no_records`, and the `invalidate_runs` privilege.

reason.description: Why, for staff only. 1 to 500 characters.

invalidated_runs.description: Existing runs it invalidated; 0 when staff chose not to.

active.description: Every ban in force, newest first.

ended.description: The 50 most recently ended or lifted.

ComplianceReport.description: The plugin's own check of the server against the ruleset.

problems.description: What doesn't match the ruleset, for people to read. Empty when compliant.

CountryList.description: Every country a player can pick for their profile, `GET /v1/countries`.

codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, A to Z. Clients name them in the reader's language.

description.description: Plain text, up to 1000 characters; null or blank clears it.

DetailsInput.description: New details for a profile. Every field is replaced: leave one out or null to clear it.

country_code.description:
An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code to show instead of Steam's or a game server's, until a run's server finds one;
null to stop showing the player's pick.

mouse.description: Up to 48 characters, one line, no links. Likewise `mouse_pad`, `keyboard` and `monitor`.

reason.description: Required when staff change someone else's details: why, for the staff log.

sensitivity.description: Above 0, up to 100; kept to 4 decimals.

Detection.description: One detection, as the anti-cheat reported it.

message.description: What the anti-cheat reported, as text.

player_name.description: The player's name on that server then.

detected_at.description: Unix seconds by the game server's clock.

message.description: What the anti-cheat reported, as text.

server_detection_id.description: The ID the game server gave this detection. Unique per server; resending is safe.

older.description: Pass as `before` for the next 50 older detections; null when there are none.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

error.description: What went wrong, for a person to read. Not meant for matching in code.

ForbiddenPlugin.description: Matches a loaded plugin by name, by file hash, or by both.

HeartbeatRequest.description: What the server is running and who's on it.

hostname.description: The server's hostname as players see it. Control characters are removed and it's cut to 64 characters.

ip.description: The server's own `ip` setting, if set. Shown to staff to spot servers behind NAT; never trusted.

players.description: Human players in the server, bots not counted.

plugins.description: Every loaded plugin, not only required ones, so staff can audit a server.

port.description: The game port (`hostport`). With the IP the heartbeat came from, it identifies the server.

ruleset_version.description: The ruleset version the plugin applied, or none if it has never fetched one.

shavit_version.description: None when the plugin can't find shavit. The heartbeat is still taken: that's a server staff need to see.

next_heartbeat_seconds.description: Seconds until the next heartbeat, unless the map changes first.

focus.description: 0 the top of the picture, 100 the bottom.

images.description: Every one of the map's pictures by ID, once, in the new order; the first is the cover.

ImageUpload.description:
The picture's bytes, sent as the whole request body. Only describes the body for the API schema; the
handler reads it as `Bytes`.

InvalidateRunsRequest.description: Give `player` (any `SteamID` form) or `server` (its ID), not both.

reason.description: Why, for the staff log. 1 to 500 characters; never shown publicly.

InvalidatedRun.description: A run as it was when it was invalidated.

id.description: The invalidation's staff log entry, for restoring it.

InvalidationEntry.description: One invalidation: of a run, of a player's, server's or key's runs, or of the runs a player sent while banned.

action.description:
`invalidate_run`, `invalidate_player_runs`, `invalidate_server_runs`, `invalidate_key_runs` (made before
a server's runs were invalidated together), or `ban_player` for the runs sent during a ban.

oneOf.description: Who did it; null for the server's command line.

key.description: For a key's runs: the key's prefix.

oneOf.description: Whose runs: the player, or the run's player.
For one run.

runs.description: How many runs it took. For a ban, how many are still invalid in its name.

server.description: For a server's or key's runs: the server's name then.

still_invalid.description: How many of those are still invalidated by it. A run restored on its own, or by restoring this, isn't.

What a personal best is worth: a map is worth `base` at tier 1 and `growth_percent` of the tier below at each
tier up; a bonus `bonus_percent` of that at its own tier. Finishing earns `finish_percent` of the value, and
the rest is earned by speed, as `(world record ÷ time) ^ speed_exponent`. Whole numbers, so policies compare.

ViewerFile.description: A map's file for the viewer.

bytes.description: Bytes on the wire, before the browser decodes it.

stock_content_url.description:
Where the viewer reads CS:S's stock content: `{stock_content_url}/{archive}_dir.vpk` and its numbered
parts, for the archives `cstrike_pak`, `hl2_textures` and `hl2_misc`, searched in that order after the
map's own packed files. Read by range request.

url.description: A stripped `.bsp`, served with `Content-Encoding: br` and cached for good.

ViewerFileUpload.description: A packed map uploaded to a link from `POST …/viewer-file/uploads`.

ViewerFileUploadLink.description: Where to upload a packed map, and the name to confirm it by.

expires_at.description: After this the URL refuses new uploads; ask for another.

upload.description: Name the upload by this once it's done (`PUT …/viewer-file`).

upload_url.description:
Send the packed map with an HTTP `PUT` to this URL, without credentials. Keep it to yourself until
it expires: whoever holds it can upload.

WorldRecord.description: The fastest personal best on a map, style and track. When times tie, the one set first holds it.

records.description: Oldest first; the last one is the current world record.

finished_at.description: When the record was set, by the game server's clock.

improvement.description: Seconds faster than the record it beat. None for the first record.

Zone.description: One zone as shavit-zones-json reads it. Optional fields are left out when unset, as shavit's own dump does.

track.description: 0 is the main track, 1 and up are bonuses.

controlled_types.description: Zone types SourceJump controls; the server's other zone sources are turned off for these.

source_url.description: Where `shavit-zones-json` loads a map's zones from.

server_key.description: The API key SourceJump issued to this game server.
